host.compiler: g++ (MinGW-W64 x86_64-ucrt-posix-seh, built by Brecht Sanders, r7) 15.2.0

protocol.eos: disabled so every run emits the same number of tokens
protocol.timing: setup prefill excluded; per-token time compared within each seed
protocol.order: baseline and speculative alternate which runs first by seed parity
protocol.concurrency: the two regimes ran concurrently in separate single-threaded processes; arms are paired within each process
protocol.speedup: baseline seconds per token / speculative seconds per token
protocol.ci95: percentile bootstrap of the median over seeds, 10000 resamples, generator seeds 264 (peaked) and 265 (flat)
protocol.sign_test: exact two-sided binomial test of speedup > 1 across seeds

scope: random-weight fixtures; Python orchestration over the native C ABI with serial target verification. Not trained-model acceptance, text quality or production speed.
